title: 1 Nuke vs. 1 Dragon
summary: Full standard armies vs (Fairy-)Stockfish, but the player's queen is replaced by a Nuke (moves like queen + nightrider) and Stockfish's queen is replaced by a Dragon (moves like knight + bishop). Game 1: player chases trades, wins the dragon for a rook via a pin (Rg1), but misclicks a promotion into a bishop and ends up stalemating the bot (Ng5 stalemate) - draw. Game 2: player closes the centre with pawns so the engine has fewer tactics, then converts and defeats Fairy Stockfish ('feels like I lost').
rules: Standard chess setup except: white queen (d1) is a Nuke, black queen (d8) is a Dragon.
Nuke: moves as queen OR nightrider (repeated knight leaps in one direction until blocked). It is a normal piece here - no explosion mentioned.
Dragon: moves as bishop OR knight (archbishop).
win_condition: Checkmate the engine. Video: game 1 stalemate (draw), game 2 win.
